- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 2-week meal plan incorporates both Kodian and Yamataian food, focusing on health and sustainability, including a variety of proteins, whole grains, fruits, and vegetables.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MORK Relief Soup is a nutritious, easy-to-make, and filling soup suitable for almost all dietary needs, prepared by MORK units during relief work.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MORK Relief Soup Recipe includes: 1 large onion, 4 cloves garlic, 2 large carrots, 2 large celery stalks, 1 large bell pepper, 1 cup chopped cabbage, 1 cup chopped kale or spinach, 1 cup chopped tomatoes, 1 cup cooked beans, 1 cup cooked lentils, 8 cups vegetable broth or water, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper, optional spices or herbs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for MORK Relief Soup: Sauté vegetables, add remaining ingredients, simmer, and serve hot with a staple like rice or bread.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MORK Relief Soup is always available in the ranger's dining facility at every meal, along with coffee and tea.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The MORK Relief Soup becomes a familiar and comforting meal for rangers and scientists during field operations, providing energy and sustenance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The frequent rainfall on Kodia III makes warm meals like soup particularly appealing and necessary for the inhabitants.
